verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent and entity-management service, so a documented public API for entity records and registered-agent appointments is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main www.wolterskluwer.com host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy CT host redirects into it. No page content was reachable, so nothing documents any API, and absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API
